name: Membrane Protein Minimization Protocol
description: 2-step minimization protocol for membrane-protein systems built with packmol-memgen. Stage 1 restrains protein and lipid phosphorus atoms (10 kcal/mol*A^2) while relaxing water, ions, and lipid tails. Stage 2 releases all restraints for full system relaxation.
author: ProPrep (based on packmol-memgen protocol)

steps.name: Restrained Minimization
steps.description: Restrained energy minimization of the membrane-protein system. Protein residues and lipid phosphorus atoms (@P31) are positionally restrained with 10 kcal/mol*A^2 to relax water, ions, and lipid tails while maintaining bilayer structure. 5000 steepest descent + 5000 conjugate gradient cycles.

steps.name: Unrestrained Minimization
steps.description: Unrestrained energy minimization of the full membrane-protein system. All restraints are released to allow the entire system to relax. 5000 steepest descent + 5000 conjugate gradient cycles.
